title: Regression TIA cannot see non-Go edges: predicates need a declared impact surface before the shadow can skip anything
routed_reason: design work on the EGPS gate input (ADR-0082); operator-approved shadow soak follow-up
summary: ADR-0082 found that every regression predicate reads files or starts a process, so the import graph selects the whole corpus and the shadow reports would_skip=0. changedpkgs.FileToPackage also rejects non-.go paths, so config-dir and profile edits (the phasespec and profiles incident classes) map to no test package. The shadow soak that the operator approved on 2026-10-21 therefore cannot show a saving until predicates declare what they observe.
fix: Design and build a declared impact surface: each go/acs/regression/<pkg> declares the files, directories and commands it observes (a manifest beside the predicates), and regressiontia.Select treats a change under a declared path as an edge. Write the design as a plan and an ADR-0082 amendment with at least three options, then build it with a test that a non-Go edit selects its predicate.
acceptance: A plan and an ADR-0082 amendment compare at least three designs for non-Go file to test-package edges
A change to a declared non-Go path selects the predicate that declares it (red test first)
evolve acs tia-report over a soak shows would_skip greater than zero, and each miss is explained
